failure.expected_behavior: The original CLI logs identify both failures; corrected arguments deliver the same stored event successfully.
failure.observed_behavior: The agent implemented watcher delivery with incompatible --sandbox workspace-write and --approve-for-me flags. Its fallback resume also omitted --skip-git-repo-check for a workspace without Git. Ten mock tests passed, with live validation explicitly pending. An authorized five-minute test completed, but archived logs showed that the real CLI rejected both delivery paths. Correcting the flags and retrying delivered the event.
